name: Absolutely Perfect Specimen
source:
Absolutely Perfect Specimen is a horror-yuri visual novel about the android maid Pan and her master Dr. Amy G Dala. Follow Pan over the course of a year as she struggles with insatiable hunger and bizarre dysphoria, all while discovering her past and grappling with her dark future.

[From [url=https://chambersoft.itch.io/absolutely-perfect-specimen]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《绝对完美样本》是一部关于机器人女仆潘和她的主人艾米·G·达拉博士的恐怖尤里视觉小说。跟随潘在一年的时间里，与永不满足的饥饿和奇怪的烦躁作斗争，同时发现她的过去并与她黑暗的未来作斗争。

[来自[url=https://chambersoft.itch.io/absolutely-perfect-specimen]Itch.io[/url]]
